Excuse me. Do you have this dress in a large?
Let me look. In blue? No, I am sorry, we do not.
I checked the screen. Blue in large: nothing, not here.
Does it come in another color, in large?
It does, actually. We have two in black, size large.
Is it the same model? Or a different one?
Exactly the same, same brand, same price. Just a different colour.
Sorry, I don't understand. Can you say that again, please?
Sorry. Same dress. Same price. Only the colour changes.
Thank you. But my daughter wants blue. Do you have it in another shop?
The King Road shop has three in blue, size large. Do you want me to call them?
Yes, please. Can you ask them to keep one until tomorrow?
Is it the same model?

A quick word about sizes and stock, because we get this question all day. What you see on the shelf is not everything we have. Most models are also in the back room, and the person with the green shirt can check the screen for you in about twenty seconds. If we do not have your size here, we can look in our other two shops in the city, and if one of them has it, we call and they keep it for you for twenty-four hours, with no cost and no payment now. If nobody has it, we can order it, but that takes five working days, so it is not useful if you go home this week. One last thing: the sizes on our labels are European, so if you come from another country, please try it on. Thank you.

Hello, this is the King Road shop calling for Patricia. My colleague on Oxford Street called us about the blue dress in size large. Good news: we do have it, and I put one aside with your name on it. I keep it until tomorrow at six in the evening, and after that it goes back on the shelf, so please do not come on Thursday. We are five minutes from Oxford Street: come out, turn right, and we are on the corner, next to the pharmacy. We open at ten and we close at seven. You do not need to pay anything now, and you can try it on when you come. If your daughter prefers the green one, I am afraid we do not have green at all, in any size, in any of our shops. Only blue and black this season. See you tomorrow.
Excuse me. Do you have this in a large? Do you have it in stock, in the back? Does it come in another color? Do you have it in another shop? Thank you very much.
